rationale.ai-review: Cross-model critique and arbitration judge AI-generated fixes before integration.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Arbitration rejects speculative, scope-expanding changes unrelated to root causes.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Final reports provide accepted and rejected fixes with reasons and attribution.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Versioned directories persist inputs, intermediate analyses, decisions, and attributions.
rationale.quality-debt: Evaluation documents complexity, breakage, and maintainability harms in generated fixes.
rationale.framework: Reusable three-phase coordination architecture integrates into CI/CD pipelines.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented SLEAN and evaluated it across fifteen debugging scenarios.
rationale.agentic: Models produce complete fix propositions for artifact-level review and arbitration.
rationale.non-developer: Scenarios explicitly simulate casual, nontechnical vibe coders.
rationale.risk-quality: Empirically analyzes generated fixes causing complexity, breakage, and production-quality violations.
